review: The actual E input is the normalized TT form completion; the complete application residual uses E_tot*, dual to [a+ell]/N. These are distinguished explicitly after the first successful development. Both source snapshots remain retained; no arithmetic assertion changed.

The linear geometric observation space is a completion of the compatible original records, without budget rescaling. This is a specification for testing the output, not a proof of a nonlinear X/Y realization, uniform C5 differentiability or an available physical margin.

The bolt observable is an original necessary admission row. Its bounded E extension follows from the accepted complete two-row estimate and actual endpoint conditions. Its radius conversion ell_b is retained. No arbitrary-source or finite-mode witness replaces the structured map.

Recomputed the physical contribution of each term in the exact two-row identity. Substitution of the accepted numerical Kb is valid in the complete mixed adjoint estimate. The new weighted source first embeds into H_mu using z<=1, then uses the same W point conversion; its resulting bound is 8.346400775 times the already available bolt return estimate.

The TT, scalar and full mixed/York physical debits are respectively 5.563904473e15, 9.216793496e25 and 1.370870984e10. These are upper-estimator entries, not measured correction amplitudes. Every one exceeds the optimistic whole margin.

Their sum exceeds the whole margin by 5.528970304e34. Removing York perfectly changes that positive expression by only 1.487362155e-16 fraction. Removing the scalar term still leaves a ratio above 3.337683372e24. Thus no single-component improvement can rescue this estimator at P32.

The joint-map conditional target is 3.323478195e33 in the original E-to-bolt norm, before subtracting any other debit. The full two-row application residual target 8.502342966e-80 is in E_tot*, not the original strong Y. Neither is an actual attained coefficient/error.

The full original-space defect, higher output maps, mass coefficient, independent phase inputs, application errors and nonlinear/physical requirements remain unknown. Failure of this necessary-row certificate suffices to reject the separated complete positive certificate, without rejecting the operator or construction.

The QCD source is an official announcement; the technical physics artifacts are withheld according to that source. No hypotheses for our curved paired finite-temperature metric variations can be checked from it, and no QCD theorem or new numerical constant is imported.

Decision: retain P32 and construction, stop the separated estimator and further York-only work, and target the joint original radius map. That next calculation is explicitly proposed rather than claimed executed.
